newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech Agrobanka says five bidding for its control.
newsitem.headline: Czech Agrobanka says five bidding for its control.

text.p: Czech Agrobanka a.s. said on Thursday that a unit of U.S. General Electric, and Austria's Raiffeisen bank, were among five bidders seeking a majority stake in the Prague-based bank through a tender.

"Between (the bidders), there is Raiffeissen, the financial concern of General Electric, some Korean (subject) and two Dutch," Agrobanka spokesman Vlastimil Nesrsta told Reuters. He declined to be more specific.
Further requests for comment were directed to HSBC Investment Bank, which is organising the tender, but a spokesman for HSBC in Prague, declined to give details.
Agrobanka was put under the administration of the Czech National Bank last September after it suffered a liquidity crisis, when several banks stopped trading with it on the interbank money market.
Agrobanka said earlier on Thursday that it would need 8.7 billion crowns in fresh reserves to cover losses accumulated up to when the central bank seized control in September.
The central bank's administrator said that the winner of the tender, to be announced later this year, must have experience in retail banking and proven financial strength.
